notes.title: The updated demo is released
notes.content: [p]Hello horror lovers, the new and updated demo of the horror game Basement is released. The Demo [/p][p]consists of 20 to 30 minutes in length. Now the players can get the complete  feel of the game. Thanks[/p]

notes.title: New Demo
notes.content: [p]We are working on a new Demo of our horror game Basement. We are increasing the length of our Demo and adding more scary elements. With this new update the players can feel the actual game and gameplay. And the Players will be emersed in to the new world of horror. Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: Basement Demo is released
notes.content: [p]HI horror lovers. the basement demo is now released and is available to play. Play the demo and get the feel of the game now.[/p]

notes.title: Demo is coming
notes.content: [p]HI, We are working on basement demo to let the gamers know more about the game and to get the feel of the game. Please check for future updates[/p]

notes.title: We changed the steam page
notes.content: [p]We have changed the steam page by adding a new gameplay trailer, new screenshots etc. We are working on our game to make it more scary and we have implemented more interactable objects, Where player can interact to know more about the story that is immersed in the game.[/p]
